cim: Ivy Tech to host Zoom artificial intelligence essential course
cim_eredeti: Ivy Tech to host Zoom artificial intelligence essential course
szoveg_eredeti:
Ivy Tech is hosting an artificial intelligence essentials course on Zoom.

Instructors will go over how AI can be used in professional environments and how it can actually help improve work flow.

They will also emphasize the crucial role of human oversight of AI.

Those who attend will also get hands-on experience with Google AI tools.

It's happening Wednesday, Nov. 18, from 9-10 a.m.

The course is free, and more information is available online.
